title: Coefficient-one open tensor restriction on pure stalk tensors
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form the pullback square sq. Let U be an open in X, let sq0 be the induced square with projections pullback.fst g′ U.ι and pullback.snd g′ U.ι, and let z0 be a point of pullback g′ U.ι. Set z=pullback.fst g′ U.ι z0 and P0=restrictFunctor U.ι applied degreewise to a complex P of modules on X. For each degree k and x in the stalk of P.X k at g′z, the composite of tensorStalkIso, inverse restriction of the output stalk, and the stalk of openTensorRestrictionComplexIso carries 1 tensor x to the restricted tensorStalkIso of 1 tensor x0. Here x0 is stalkCongr along the point equality from pullback.condition followed by inverse restrictStalkNatIso U.ι applied to x. All comparisons are the specified ones of the definition nodes, not arbitrary choices.

proof.text: On a section representative, invert the unit-germ formula of exists_tensorPullback_stalk_iso. stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply and stalkPushforward_germ_apply identify the result with the additive stalk map of the tensor-pullback adjunction unit. The private proved helper tensor_unit_stalk performs this calculation for every stalk element.

The specified component equation exists_tensorStalkIso expresses each degree of tensorStalkIso as eqToHom followed by that inverse pullback-stalk isomorphism. Equality induction on the scalar-extension map, in tensor_unit_stalk_cast, removes eqToHom from a coefficient-one tensor. exists_tensorMap supplies the required equality with the actual morphism stalk map. Apply this to both the ambient and restricted square, and use map_one on the projection stalk ring map.

The degree component of openTensorRestrictionComplexIso is the underived openTensorRestrictionSquareIso component. After the two coordinate calculations, apply openTensorRestrictionSquare_stalk_unit to M=P.X k and evaluate its equality of additive maps on x. This gives exactly the required equation, including inverse input/output restriction maps and stalkCongr along pullback.condition.

theorem openRestricted_tensor_chain_transport_pure_one
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (sq0 : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z0 : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u}))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let z := pullback.fst g' U.ι z0
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Pg := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z0)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
    letI := leftAlgebra (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    letI := rightAlgebra (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0
    letI := (tensorMap (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (R (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') z0))
    let R0 := R (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    let A0 := A (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    let B0 := B (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') z0
    let Q := stalkComplex g' z P
    let hp : g' z = U.ι (pullback.snd g' U.ι z0) :=
      congrArg (fun h : pullback g' U.ι ⟶ X => h z0) pullback.condition
    ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : Q.X k),
      (F.map ((tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z P).hom.f k) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (pullback.fst g' U.ι) z0).inv.app (Pg.X k) ≫
        F0.map ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor
          (pullback g' U.ι).toRingedSpace z0).map
            ((openTensorRestrictionComplexIso g' U P).hom.f k)))
          ((1 : C z) ⊗ₜ[A g' z, (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).comp
            (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z))] x) =
      F0.map ((tensorStalkIso (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0 P0).hom.f k)
          (((pullback.fst g' U.ι).stalkMap z0).hom (1 : C z) ⊗ₜ[A0,
            (tensorMap (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
              g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0).comp
              (algebraMap A0 (A0 ⊗[R0] B0))]
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι (pullback.snd g' U.ι z0)).inv.app
              (P.X k) (((show X.Modules from P.X k).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hp)).hom x)))
